sample_unit: healthcare professionals involved in radiology services

links.outcome: Perceived barriers to AI integration in radiology, including insufficient staff training
links.effect: Insufficient staff training rated a major barrier (3.84 ± 0.77) and lack of technical expertise (3.82 ± 0.78); implementation readiness was lower (3.04 ± 0.79).
links.quote: Major barriers included implementation costs (3.98 ± 0.71), limited digital infrastructure (3.90 ± 0.75), insufficient staff training (3.84 ± 0.77), and lack of technical expertise (3.82 ± 0.78).

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of 295 healthcare professionals in radiology evaluating workforce readiness, attitudes, knowledge, and implementation barriers for AI integration.
